summary: AXS summary views must preserve semantic firmware strings and distinguish zero-valued battery readings from missing data.
reason: Dotted firmware versions cannot be represented as JSON numbers, while a 0% battery reading is valid data; incorrect value types silently produced null firmware columns or omitted genuine zero readings.
validated_outcome: Firmware versions retain every segment, numeric fallbacks stringify safely, zero battery readings remain present in JSON, and regression tests plus Go test, vet, and build pass.
